name: Elite
eligibility_criteria: Top-tier strategic partners (Registered < Silver < Gold < Elite): signed annual framework agreements, joint marketing primary host responsibilities, approved by APAC VP.
notes: Co-op reimbursement ratio 70% is formally documented policy (Gold 50%, Elite 70%). Single-event cap is not explicitly mandated in corporate documents; per Iron Invariant 3 (zero guessing), cap_configured = false and single_event_cap = null until confirmed by administrator.

name: Gold
eligibility_criteria: Certified joint marketing partners meeting procurement threshold, entitled to 50% co-op reimbursement and RM 10,000 single-event cap.
notes: Single-event cap RM 10,000 and 50% co-op matching ratio are official policy values under ADR-003 effective 2026-03-01.

name: Silver
eligibility_criteria: Documented member of 4-tier ladder (Registered < Silver < Gold < Elite); specific tier policy criteria awaiting administrative confirmation.
notes: Unconfigured tier: displays 'No active policy configured'. All limits show 'Not configured / Needs confirmation'. Policy rules yield NOT_EVALUATED and route to human reviewer.

name: Registered
eligibility_criteria: Baseline tier (level 0): registered in partner master but pending annual procurement or accreditation review.
notes: Draft status: Tier exists in terminology glossary, but co-op limits require individual administrator sign-off.

name: Other / Unassigned
eligibility_criteria: Fallback tier: applies to partners without confirmed tier assignment or during system cold-start.
notes: Fallback state: default rules applied. Tier-dependent limit rules bypass automated evaluation and route to manual review.
